description: On the Central Heritage Road, Vinpearl Resort & Golf Nam Hoi An is the "happiness center" of the resort, entertainment, golf and cultural experience complex Vinpearl Nam Hoi An. The hotel building in the shape of a giant sail facing the 1.3km long pristine Binh Minh beach forms a masterpiece that harmonizes contemporary architectural style and the beauty of nature. Vinpearl Resort & Golf Nam Hoi An is the perfect destination for a family vacation with cultural experiences and edutainment products exclusively for children, and also ideal for MICE or reward tourism thanks to its excellent service and a system of superior meeting rooms to cater for events of up to 600 guests.

The quintessence of international cuisine
At Vinpearl Resort & Golf Nam Hoi An, visitors embark on a culinary journey of diverse flavors, from international buffet and tranquil afternoon tea to authentic Korean cuisine or luxurious fine dining, promising to satisfy the whole family.
An Restaurant
11:00AM - 10:00PM
(+84) 235 367 6888
(+84) 235 367 6888
A modern oriental space offering pan-Asian cuisine featuring authentic elements of Korean BBQ, Indian & Chinese flavours. An Restaurant offers a warm, relaxed vibe ideal for contemporary dining.
Cocoon Restaurant
Breakfast: 6:00AM - 10:30AM
Lunch: 12:00PM - 2:00PM
Dinner: 6:00PM - 10:00PM
(+84) 235 367 6888
(+84) 235 367 6888
Simple spacious and airy, Cocoon Restaurant offers a casual modern dining experience with everything from international classics to contemporary Southeast Asian fusion. A gourmet’s delight offering flavors to suit every taste.
Lantern Restaurant
Breakfast: 6:00AM - 10:30AM
Lunch: 12:00PM - 2:00PM
Dinner: 6:00PM - 10:00PM
(+84) 235 367 6888
(+84) 235 367 6888
Beautifully designed with stunning garden views, the Lantern Restaurant offer a luxurious space from which to take in a stunning array of authentic and rich Vietnamese dishes, not to mention the very best in contemporary European cuisine.
Lobby bar
8:00AM - 11:00PM
(+84) 235 367 6888
(+84) 235 367 6888
Simple, unfussy, modern, our lengthy Lobby Bar is a perfect spot for guests to unwind, while sipping on a collection of hand-crafted cocktails and gourmet bar snacks, featuring the very finest local ingredients.
Latitude Rooftop Bar
2:00PM - 00:00PM
(+84) 235 367 6888
(+84) 235 367 6888
Located on the 9th floor of the hotel, Latitude Rooftop Bar is where guests can sip on refreshing cocktails while watching the brilliant sunset over the horizon.
Pool Bar
Summer: 09:00AM - 10:00PM
Winter: 09:00AM - 8:00PM
(+84) 235 367 6888
(+84) 235 367 6888
Located right next to the signature shell-shaped swimming pool, Pool Bar is a place to chill the day away with your beloveds while listening to the sound of the ocean and enjoy the bartenders' talents with mind-blowing cocktails and mocktails.
